bootstrap_method: Circular moving-block bootstrap over ordered reference frames. Block length 1 is frame/node bootstrap; lengths 5 and 10 preserve short-range temporal dependence.
pair_weight: For pair (i,j), weight = multiplicity(frame_i) * multiplicity(frame_j). Pairs with identical endpoints are excluded because the manifest contains no self-pairs.
warning: Intervals are conditional on this one sequence and its COLMAP-derived reference labels. They do not establish between-sequence or between-site generalization. Circular blocks assume endpoint wraparound; block-length sensitivity should be reported.
